description.tagline: Shocking design for the little ones
description.intro: The Arsenal for Children's Adidas 2025/2026 T-shirt stands out for its combination of emblematic colors and modern details. Inspired by the players' equipment, this garment allows young fans to wear the shield with pride. Its recycled fabric guarantees comfort and commitment to the environment.
key_benefits: Club identity: Arsenal's official design for the 25th season 26.
Comfort for the day to day: Light and soft fabric for long use.
Modern children's style: Fit adapted to young footballers.
Breathability: Material that helps keep dry during physical activity.
